title: Preserve correlated Build terminal outcomes and distinguish validation rejection from missing exit
outcome: Repair the bounded foreground Build terminal-outcome propagation/correlation boundary and retain the actual reason when its native outcome cannot earn credit. Plain Cargo and supported focused Node launcher paths use their own command key/attempt terminal event, never yield/detach confusion or a foreign outcome. Retain observed native exit separately from artifact/association eligibility, preserve existing source/claim/grant/provenance/overlap/capture/interval defenses, and fix a timing boundary only when deterministic regression establishes it. Historical 92e1f050 runtime/native0 versus hostUNKNOWN remains attributed and its original unproved ingress/guard cause is not retrospectively asserted. This is not a claim to solve every older unknown-cause family; their reports and existing history remain. After landing, report result and concrete next options, with no unrelated automatic work.
acceptance: A recognized foreground Cargo Build, plain or through the supported focused Node launcher, consumes the terminal outcome of its own command key/attempt through the actual recorder-to-host path: valid correlated exit 0 records passed Build and valid correlated nonzero exit records failed Build. Yield or nested execution is not treated as launcher detach; a foreign, reused or stale command outcome cannot grant credit.

Missing terminal ingress is distinguished from a present native terminal rejected by artifact or association validation. Unknown verification summaries preserve the observed exit when present and a bounded specific rejection reason (owner/root/path/argv, terminal/interval/input or association), without granting PASS from exit alone or claiming missing exit when an exit was observed. Reasons survive existing summary bounds and appear through the existing diagnostic path; no new logging service.

A deterministic command-start/terminal regression exercises delayed host bookkeeping and the genuine focused-launcher validator. If it reproduces rejection solely because the check timestamp was assigned after target/capture resolution, fix the smallest correlated start boundary while rejecting pre-start replayed runs and preserving source/claim/grant/provenance/capture/overlap defenses. Node Test and carried full/live behavior remain intact.

Record the retained 92e1f050 foreground request/results and runtime/host witnesses, the source-backed None-to-Unknown loss and the fail-first regression diagnosis. Distinguish reproduced boundary defects from unproved historical ingress/guard cause; do not rerun the original observation, infer common cause or mark its unpassed criterion satisfied by this repair.
